mapper.insert: insert into borrow_record(book_id, reader_id, book_title, reader_name, borrow_date, due_date, actual_return_date, status) values(#{bookId}, #{readerId}, #{bookTitle}, #{readerName}, #{borrowDate}, #{dueDate}, #{actualReturnDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: update borrow_record set book_id = #{bookId}, reader_id = #{readerId}, book_title = #{bookTitle}, reader_name = #{readerName}, borrow_date = #{borrowDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, actual_return_date = #{actualReturnDate}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from borrow_record where book_id = #{bookId} and reader_id = #{readerId} and status != '已还'
select book_title, count(*) as total_borrow_times from borrow_record group by book_title order by total_borrow_times desc, book_title asc limit #{limit}

select count(*) from borrow_record
and (book_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or reader_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or status like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
